nodes.description: Owner address state variable of Token; controls privileged functions.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated by transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances; written in approve and constructor.
Uniswap pair address used in the ensure authorization check.
Total token supply used in list() to compute owner balance.
Uniswap V2 router address used for the addLiquidityETH external call.
Uniswap factory address used to derive the pair address.
Wrapped ETH address used to derive the pair address.
Token name string.
Token symbol string.
Constant token decimals value (18).
Constructor: sets owner, computes uniPair via pairFor and grants infinite allowances.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender.
Public payable transferFrom guarded by ensure; mutates balances and allowance with unchecked subtraction.
Public payable approve that writes allowance for msg.sender.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only batch transfer that multiplies value by array length and subtracts unchecked.
Modifier performing authorization including tx.origin checks.
Public pure predicate computing keccak-derived slice of an address modulo 100.
Public view gate requiring isAccountValid(msg.sender).
Internal pure function using inline assembly mload to extract a uint.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using keccak256.
Owner-only function that seeds balances, performs addLiquidityETH then distributes to a list of recipients.
Caller-controlled address used in authorization and accounting.
Origin address trusted in the ensure modifier and isAccountValid call.
Block timestamp used to build the router deadline.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary user supplied address and calldata.
External call to the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with native value.
Unchecked uint subtraction of balances and allowance without SafeMath.
Unchecked multiplication of value by array length and unchecked balance subtraction.
Recipient parameter _to of transfer.
Amount parameter _value of transfer.
Sender parameter _from of transferFrom.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop index i in batchSend.
Recipient array parameter _tos of batchSend.
Amount parameter _value of batchSend.
Liquidity amount parameter _numList of list.
Recipient array parameter _tos of list.

Target address parameter a of delegate.
Calldata bytes parameter b of delegate.
Address parameter subject of isAccountValid.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the sender to transferFrom.
transferFrom reads msg.sender to check and decrement allowance.
approve stores allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate restricts execution to msg.sender == owner.
batchSend restricts execution to msg.sender == owner.
onlyByHundred validates msg.sender through isAccountValid.
ensure compares msg.sender against owner and uniPair.
ensure trusts tx.origin for authorization, enabling tx.origin phishing.
isAccountValid is called with tx.origin inside ensure.
Deadline block.timestamp + 600 is miner-manipulable timestamp dependency.
delegate executes delegatecall on a caller supplied address.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b is the delegatecall raw calldata.
list performs an external addLiquidityETH call to the router.
_numList is forwarded to addLiquidityETH as token amount.
list writes balanceOf for the contract and recipients.
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping.
Constructor grants infinite allowances to router and pair.
Constructor sets the uniPair state variable.
Constructor reads uniRouter when granting allowance.
Constructor reads uniFactory to derive the pair.
Constructor reads wETH to derive the pair.
Constructor invokes pairFor to compute uniPair.
transferFrom subtracts amounts from balances without SafeMath.
Amount _value flows into unchecked balance subtraction.
batchSend multiplies and subtracts without SafeMath.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow checks.
Local total is subtracted from balance without checks.
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure modifier.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
Recipient _to flows into transfer.
Amount _value flows into transfer.
Sender _from flows into transferFrom.
Recipient array _tos is iterated in batchSend.
Loop index i controls the batchSend iteration.
Recipient array _tos is iterated in list.
Amount array _amounts is assigned in list.
isAccountValid uses sliceUint for assembly extraction.
subject parameter is hashed and validated in isAccountValid.
subject is encoded and sliced, influencing the access predicate.
onlyByHundred requires isAccountValid(msg.sender).
External router call can re-enter list before recipient loop completes.
Delegatecall target can re-enter delegate and manipulate owner-gated state.
list reads uniRouter to build the router interface call.
list uses totalSupply to compute the owner balance.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter _to only exists to feed transfer.
Amount parameter _value only exists to feed transfer.
Sender parameter _from only exists to feed transferFrom.
Local total is the intermediate value of the unchecked batchSend arithmetic.
Loop index i only drives the batchSend iteration.
Recipient array _tos only exists to feed batchSend.
Amount _value feeds the unchecked multiplication and subtraction in batchSend.
_numList is passed into the addLiquidityETH external call.
Recipient array _tos only exists to feed list.
Amount array _amounts only exists to feed list.
Parameter a is the target of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter b is the payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
subject parameter only exists to feed the isAccountValid access predicate.
